name: web-commerce-stripe-template-ci-tooling
description: Pinned devDependencies for the Stripe templates' node:test suites (framework + static tiers), run by .github/workflows/validate-web-commerce-templates.yml. CI tooling only: consumers copy a tier directory (framework/ or static/) into their own app, and this file sits above both. A committed lockfile (npm ci) is required rather than an ad-hoc `npm install <pkg>@version` in the workflow -- zizmor's adhoc-packages audit flags an inline install as an unpinned transitive-dependency risk. No "type" field on purpose: the tests import ../checkout without an extension and were verified under the CommonJS default, which an absent field preserves.
